source_file: 狮子牙和丝绸爪子(4-7 岁).ppt
full_text_zh:
[P1] 狮子牙和丝绸爪子
这是一个美丽缤纷的故事。
故事的主人公是两个小老鼠。
他们彼此相爱，生了两个孩子。
一个叫狮子牙，另一个叫丝绸爪子。

[P2] 住在咖啡壶里的母老鼠和公老鼠，
过着幸福的生活，
可总觉得还缺点儿什么。

从前有个母老鼠和一个公老鼠，他们结婚了，住在欧洲越橘林附近的、一片草地边上的、一个舒适的咖啡壶里。咖啡壶的前面是他们的小园子。
他们日子过得挺好。
一切都称心如意。
他们有足够的吃食儿，因为咖啡壶旁边就是庄稼地。他们有足够的过冬的核桃，因为咖啡壶旁边就是一棵大核桃树。
他们有很多取暖的柴火，多到他们背不动的地步，因为在欧洲越橘林有成千上万棵大树，每棵大树都很粗壮，三百个老鼠手拉手也抱不过来。
三百个老鼠，手拉手，围不住一棵大树，没错。
总而言之，公老鼠和母老鼠什么都不缺。
有一天，母老鼠说：
“我们想要的我们都有了，可以说一切称心如意。但是，老公你知道吗？生活虽然很幸福，我还是觉得缺点儿什么。”
“是缺点儿什么！”公老鼠说。
“缺点儿什么呢？”
“孩子。”
没错，就是缺孩子。每当公老鼠一个人在园子里剪花儿的时候，尤其是活儿干得不顺手的时候，他就想，要是有个儿子就好了。他可以从另一头儿把剪下来的花儿收起来，替自己分担一半儿的活计。
要是有两个儿子就更好了。他们能把全部的活儿都干了，当爹的就可以安安静静地坐在园子里抽袋烟。真是越

[P3] 想越美。
可是，他连一个儿子也没有。
更不要说两个了。
还有，有时候，公老鼠看见狐狸嚣张地闯进他的园子，他能做的也就是从远处对狐狸挥挥拳头，吓唬吓唬他：“你这个坏蛋，走着瞧！等我有了儿子，立刻把你打回老家；不用剃毛膏也不用湿毛巾，把你干剃了；再把你踹飞，让你没有飞机一直飞到汉诺威。你这个侏儒！”
母老鼠的想法跟公老鼠的差不多。每当晚上，她在灯底下缝衣服，眼睛看不清的时候，她便对老公说：“要是有个女儿就好了。”一个勤快的女儿可以帮妈妈穿针引线，因为她眼睛好；她还可以帮妈妈缝衣服，因为她的 小手很柔软。那样，当娘的就可以坐在沙发里，安安静静地看看报纸。也是越想越美。
可是，她没有女儿。
“老公，我们应该生个女儿。”母老鼠说。
“不对，最好生个儿子。”公老鼠说。
“生个女儿。”
“生个儿子。”
“女儿。”
“儿子。”
他们吵来吵去，夏天在他们的争吵中过去了，他们一个孩子也没得到。
原因你们知道吧！

[P4] 使人幸福的快乐
和怎样用核桃壳做婴儿车轮子。

这个冬天冷极了，两个小老鼠要是没有炉子的话，可能就被冻死了。好在春天来了，太阳照耀着他们，晒得手脚暖融融的。他们很快乐，一快乐就忘了生孩子的事了。因为快乐使人幸福。可是，有一天，还是发生了一件事。啊，你已经知道发生什么事了？没错，就是那么回事。
那个白天……对了，对小老鼠来说，白天是他们的夜晚，夜晚是他们的白天，所以他们白天睡觉，夜里工作。夜里工作的好处是谁都看不见他们，不被人看见就不会被人抓住，不被人抓住就不会被人吃掉。正是因为这个，猫长的都是绿眼睛。于是他们才能在暗处看见老鼠，抓到老鼠，最后吃掉老鼠。一物降一物。这一天……
这天白天，也就是小老鼠的晚上，他们两个躺在床上睡觉，呼噜打得跟野驴一样响。

因为他们两个夜里干了太多的活儿。于是，就在这一天，在他们睡觉的时候，他们生了两个孩子。
“噢，”公老鼠叫起来，“儿子！”
“不对，”母老鼠叫着，“女儿！”
“儿子！”
“女儿！”
嗨，做父母的，你们不能不吵架吗？！
两个孩子：一个儿子一个女儿。
天哪，这真是太好了，咖啡壶里的一件大喜事！当了父母的两个老鼠，开始了忙碌的生活：他们给孩子找最好的吃食儿；把孩子从前到后洗个遍……公老鼠从护林员家带回来一个几乎是新的火柴盒，用它给小老鼠们做了一张小床。
应该让孩子们舒舒服服的，所以让他们睡在火柴盒里。
“老婆，我们现在彻底地幸福了。”公老鼠说。他还用核桃壳做了一辆有两个小轮子的婴儿车——推孩子散步时用的婴儿车。

[P5] 星期天下午，两个老鼠带着孩子在森林里散步，目的是显摆显摆自己的孩子，跟别人吹吹牛，骄傲一把。公老鼠舒服地叼着他的小烟斗，走在前面。当爹的嘛，总是走在前面。哎呀，难道你们疯了吗？你们两个傻瓜！要是被老猫酷魔逮住了，你们就完蛋了。他会把你们连毛吃了。
骄傲制造傻瓜。
“儿子叫狮子牙吧。”公老鼠说，“那样，他就会像狮子那么强壮，估计也能长成狮子那么大个儿。那样，他才能对付狐狸那个恶棍，吓得他没完没了地冒冷汗。”
母老鼠想给女儿起名叫丝绸爪子。
“因为姑娘应该是温柔的、可爱的、勤快的、聪明的。”她说。
“现在，为孩子们该想的我们都想到了。”公老鼠说，“狮子牙要像狮子一样强壮，丝绸爪子像一个温柔可爱的小老鼠。”
但是，事与愿违。

[P6] 你好,蝴蝶先生!

跟父母想的正好相反。狮子牙一点儿个子也没长,一直是小小的、瘦瘦的,但很聪明。

丝绸爪子既不温柔也不可爱,织织补补的事她一点兴趣也没有。她像土匪头子一样大胆、鲁莽。走路?她几乎是脚不沾地儿,总是爬到最高的树枝儿上随着风打秋千,风刮得越大,她越高兴。

有时,她从高处往下跳:“靠边儿,狮子牙,我跳了……”

有时,她爬到小树上,挂在一片树叶上,往下飞——降落伞!这是需要勇气的事情,这是让人心里痒痒的事情。总之是美好的事情。

可是,父母开始为他们操心。

“这两个孩子什么时候才能有出息啊?!”父母替孩子发愁。公老鼠从城里给狮子牙带回了半盒壮力的猫粮罐头,让儿子吃,希望他因此变得强壮。但是,狮子牙根本不吃,他说:

“老爸,这罐头的味道像猫粮,我不吃,因为我不是猫。”

可是,丝绸爪子却很爱吃。她每天能吃五份儿,变得越来越壮实,越来越有勇气。很快,降落伞之类的把戏对她来说,已经不够刺激了。

“哎,狮子牙,你看,大家都是从上往下飞,”丝绸爪子说,“我要反过来,从下往上飞,像导弹一样。”

“这并不难。”狮子牙说。接着他用两根柳条儿做了一个像老鼠弹弓一样的东西,把两头儿插到地里,用两块大石头压住,剩下的事把獾子叫来就行了。

12

13

[P7] 可父母还是为他们操心。
“这丫头什么都学不到，”老鼠妈妈说，“因为她没有书。”于是，她从图书馆背回了七袋子带字的纸片儿。这些差不多够一个教授看的了，当然，是一个水平不那么高的教授。

丝绸爪子一页也没看，狮子牙通通看完，一页不剩。你想想，这么一来，他得多聪明。
很快，老鼠弹弓之类的飞行，对丝绸爪子来说，已经不够刺激，不够高，也不够远了。
她想在空气中飞，像鸟儿一样。
“给我抓架飞机，狮子牙。”
“太容易了。”狮子牙说，他在向日葵上放了一个套子。
“您好，蝴蝶先生。请您过来一下，闻闻向日葵的花香，一点儿也不危险。”

“麻烦您过来一下，獾子先生。您帮忙把老鼠弹弓的这头往下拉住。对，对，就这样。邻居嘛，总是要互相帮忙的。好了，现在，丝绸爪子，你上去，马上发射。倒计时。注意了：四——三——二——一——零！”
哦，太酷了！
平安降落了吗，丝绸爪子？
祝贺你！

[P8] 对，就这样，对，对，抓住了。
“您别老扑动翅膀，没您想的那么严重。请您原谅，
我们得把您绑上，因为我们需要一架小飞机。只是借您用
一下，之后将恢复您的自由。登机，丝绸爪子，到那个蓝
色的吊篮里去。现在注意，起飞了。到上面向我招招手，
亲爱的小妹妹。”

哦，酷毙了。
下面是那么大的草坪。
我们那好心肠的父母住在哪里？啊，在那儿……
“狮子牙，我在向你招手。兄弟，你能看见我吗？”

[P9] 核桃壳是一只小船，
小纽扣是个小老鼠，
王冠是一个国王的。

“我当了一回小鸟，狮子牙，因为我在天空飞过了。”
丝绸爪子说，“现在我想当回鱼，你替我弄艘潜水艇。”
说得容易，潜水艇可不是满天飞的。你得先知道，怎样给小老鼠造个潜水罩子。这很容易。你先在澡盆的水上
放个火柴盒，火柴盒会漂在水上。然后在火柴盒里放个小
纽扣。小纽扣上面系一条线。那条线就是小尾巴，小纽扣
就是小老鼠。火柴盒就是那小船。现在，你拿个玻璃杯
子，罩住火柴盒小船，连同小老鼠，还有小老鼠的尾巴，
一同笔直往下压。
结果怎么样呢？潜水罩子里有空气，小老鼠就可以呼吸。而且小船不会沉到水里，因为它是干的。这样，小老鼠就可以划着小船在潜水罩子里游动，四下观看。
谁还能做得更精彩？
现在，可以把一块石头放到潜水罩子上，不然的话，
罩子自己会浮出水面。小老鼠在小船里，可以一直待到没有空气为止，待到所有氧气用完为止。

用这个潜水罩子肯定能成功。
“丝绸爪子，你先帮我抬东西去，我们需要一只真正
的小船。”

[P10] 然后把一块石头绑到玻璃杯上，绳子的一头甩到杯子里面。
“丝绸爪子，如果你想浮出水面，就扯杯里面的绳子，那样，石头就会滑下去，潜水罩子就会升起来。你能记住吗？”
没问题。
“您能过来一下吗，水獭太太？您小心地拿住这个潜水罩子，因为，邻居嘛，总是要互相帮忙的，对不对？现在，您用潜水罩子盖住核桃壳小船。在小船里坐着的是我妹妹。小心！现在，潜水罩子下潜。潜水艇入水。非常感谢，水獭太太。”
“分内之事。邻居嘛，总是要互相帮忙的。”
谁那么讨厌，敲我的潜水艇？是个绿色的家伙。护林员是绿色的，但护林员有胡子。你有胡子吗？没有啊，那你就是青蛙。你想进来吗，青蛙？不想啊，聪明。想，你也进不来。
海底的这个王冠是谁的？也许是金子做的？就是金子的。金子的王冠就是国王的。
这把钥匙呢？这把钥匙是谁的？也是一个国王的？不是，钥匙是侍卫长斯提费乐可内西的。去年夏天，他在这儿洗澡的时候丢的。这把钥匙是洗衣房的，所以他老婆现在也不能洗衣服了，所以，他们现在也没有干净的衬衫和裤子了，所以，他们现在去哪儿都得光着身子了。为什么呢？就是因为没有照看好钥匙啊。

[P11] 哦,狮子牙,世界多美!
在家门口的田野里,丝绸爪子对狮子牙说:
“蓝天属于我们,因为我们能飞。同样道理,大海、
广阔的麦田和巨大的核桃树都属于我们,因为我们需要它
们。狮子牙,我们必须了解整个世界,来个环球旅行,不
仅要去,还要再回来,怎么样?”
“没问题。”狮子牙说,“这房子后面住着农夫米歇尔,
他有辆很棒的汽车。来吧,丝绸爪子,我们抓紧时间。”
农夫米歇尔早上七点进城,卖鸡蛋,买钉子,因为
他在修篱笆。
“再见了,亲爱的青蛙,我很高兴认识你。我现在要
拉绳子了,石头滚下去之后,潜水艇便浮上去了。”一次美
好的冒险。
22
23

[P12] “快点儿，丝绸爪子，快点儿，现在已经六点半了，
我们还得走挺远呢。谁去晚了，谁就搭不上车。”
现在，使劲跳，跳进尾灯里，丝绸爪子，哥哥拉你一把！米歇尔先生，您的尾灯坏了，这很危险，您知道吗？
这是要被罚的。但愿他别被警察抓到，不然，丝绸爪子必须逃跑，那样，她的环球旅行就泡汤了。

这会儿，他们的父母毫无必要地替他们担着心，毫无
意义地让自己痛苦。
每当他们坐在灯下，母亲自己缝补衣服，父亲忍受着
剪花造成的手腕疼痛，这时，公老鼠就会说：
“我们的孩子将来到底会出息成什么样子呢？狮子牙
小得跟一个苍蝇似的，他永远也吃不了狐狸。天哪！”
母老鼠对女儿丝绸爪子同样不满意。

[P13] 七点，米歇尔开着他的呱呱叫的汽车出发了。
“再见了，丝绸爪子，早点回来！”
“把你看见的所有事儿，不管什么事儿都告诉我，我在这儿等你。”
嗨，熊先生，你们已经被看见了，快藏到麦田里去吧！

[P14] 中午十二点整，农夫米歇尔回家了。他饿了想吃午饭。他也从城里带回了钉子。在城里，刚停好车，丝绸爪子就从尾灯里跳了出来。
“当心，你们这些人，免得我跳到你们脚上！”

丝绸爪子冒着生命危险在城里转了一圈，差点被人踩死。小心啊，丝绸爪子。好在农夫米歇尔很快把她带了回来。
这可真是一趟快速旅行。给我讲讲，丝绸爪子，你的所见所闻！
“哦，狮子牙，世界太美好了，”丝绸爪子说，“可惜人太多。我能够死里逃生，算是幸运。狮子牙，我的好兄弟，我们经历了一次环球旅行，对不对？世界真美好。”
接着，他们回家去了，回父母家暖暖身子。

另外一个母老鼠和另外一个公老鼠
住在果酱盒子里，过着幸福生活，
可是，他们也觉得缺了点儿什么。

又是一个美丽的冬天过去了。丝绸爪子和狮子牙一起滑雪，还朝护林员扔雪球，可惜没打着。
离得太远了。
他们攥着拳头，连喊带吓唬，警告狐狸：
“你倒是过来啊，你这个胆小鬼，你过来，我们就扒你的皮！”
狐狸没过去，也许是胆儿小吧。不过，对狐狸来说，胆儿小没什么不好，至少保全了性命。
丝绸爪子和狮子牙堆了一个雪人儿。哦，对不起，说错了。应该说堆了一个雪老鼠。一个人儿是个老鼠，一个雪人儿就是一个雪老鼠。这样说才正确。

春天来的时候，丝绸爪子跟一个年轻的公老鼠结婚了。他们住在一个舒适的果酱盒子里，日子过得很不错，因为他们想有的都有了。

[P15] “你知道吗，对于我们的好日子来说，似乎还缺点儿什么。”丝绸爪子说。
“我看也是。”年轻的公老鼠说，“我们缺孩子，准确地说是缺儿子。”
“缺女儿。”丝绸爪子说。
“儿子。”
“女儿。”丝绸爪子坚持说，“她们可以帮我做针线活儿。”
“儿子可以吃狐狸。”
哦，做父母的，你们干吗总是吵架？
他们生了好多儿子和女儿。所有孩子都跟父母想象的不一样：跟父母期望的正好相反。
嗨，狮子牙，你去哪儿啊？
“进城去，让自己成为一个名人。再见了，朋友们，你们有一天会听到我的好消息。再见……”
再见
full_text_en:
[P1] Lion Tooth and Silk Claw
This is a beautiful and colorful story.
The main characters are two little mice.
They loved each other and had two children.
One was named Lion Tooth, the other Silk Claw.

[P2] The mother mouse and father mouse, living in a coffee pot,
were living a happy life,
yet always felt something was missing.

Once upon a time, there was a mother mouse and a father mouse who got married and lived in a cozy coffee pot near the European blueberry forest, by a grassy field. In front of the coffee pot was their little garden.
They were living quite well.
Everything was going smoothly.
They had enough food, because right next to the coffee pot was farmland. They had enough walnuts for winter, because right next to the coffee pot was a big walnut tree.
They had plenty of firewood for warmth, so much that they couldn't carry it all, because in the European blueberry forest there were thousands of big trees, each very thick, and even three hundred mice holding hands couldn't wrap around one.
Three hundred mice, holding hands, couldn't encircle a single big tree. That's for sure.
In short, the father mouse and mother mouse had everything.
One day, the mother mouse said:
"We have everything we want. We can say everything is going smoothly. But, honey, do you know? Life is happy, yet I still feel something is missing."
"What's missing?" the father mouse said.
"What's missing?"
"Children."
Indeed, what was missing was children. Whenever the father mouse was alone in the garden trimming flowers, especially when the work wasn't going well, he would think, it would be great to have a son. He could collect the cut flowers from the other end and share half the work.
It would be even better to have two sons. They could do all the work, and then the father could sit quietly in the garden smoking his pipe. It was truly getting

[P3] The more he thought about it, the more beautiful it seemed.
But he didn't even have a son.
Let alone two.
Also, sometimes, when the father mouse saw the fox brazenly闯 into his garden, all he could do was wave his fists from afar and scare him: “You rascal, just wait! When I have a son, I’ll knock you right back home; no shaving cream, no wet towel, I’ll shave you dry; then I’ll kick you so hard you’ll fly all the way to Hanover without an airplane. You little dwarf!”
The mother mouse’s thoughts were much the same as the father’s. Every evening, when she was sewing under the lamp and her eyesight was blurry, she would say to her husband, “It would be wonderful to have a daughter.” A diligent daughter could help her mother thread the needle, because she had good eyesight; she could also help her mother sew clothes, because her little hands were soft. Then, the mother could sit on the sofa, quietly reading the newspaper. It was also more beautiful the more she thought about it.
But she didn’t have a daughter.
“Honey, we should have a daughter,” the mother mouse said.
“No, we should have a son,” the father mouse said.
“Have a daughter.”
“Have a son.”
“Daughter.”
“Son.”
They argued back and forth, and summer passed in their quarrels, and they didn’t get a child at all.
You know the reason, right!

[P4] The Happiness That Makes People Happy
And How to Make Baby Carriage Wheels from Walnut Shells.

This winter was extremely cold. If the two little mice hadn't had a stove, they might have frozen to death. Fortunately, spring came, and the sun shone on them, warming their hands and feet. They were very happy, and once happy, they forgot all about having children. Because happiness makes people happy. But one day, something still happened. Ah, you already know what happened, right? Yes, exactly that.
That day... right, for the little mice, daytime was their night, and nighttime was their day. So they slept during the day and worked at night. The advantage of working at night was that no one could see them. If no one saw them, they wouldn't be caught, and if not caught, they wouldn't be eaten. That's why cats have green eyes. Only then could they see mice in the dark, catch them, and finally eat them. One thing defeats another. This day...
This day, which was the little mice's night, the two of them lay in bed sleeping, snoring like wild donkeys.

Because they had done so much work at night. So, on this day, while they were sleeping, they gave birth to two children.
"Oh!" cried the father mouse, "A son!"
"No!" cried the mother mouse, "A daughter!"
"Son!"
"Daughter!"
Hey, you parents, can't you stop arguing?! 
Two children: a son and a daughter.
Oh my, this is wonderful, a great joy in the coffee pot! The two mice, now parents, began their busy life: they found the best food for the children; washed them from head to toe... The father mouse brought back a nearly new matchbox from the forest ranger's house and used it to make a small bed for the little mice.
They should be comfortable, so they let the children sleep in the matchbox.
"Honey, we are completely happy now," said the father mouse. He also made a baby carriage with two small wheels from walnut shells — a carriage for pushing the children for walks.

[P5] On Sunday afternoon, the two mice took their children for a walk in the forest, intending to show off their kids, brag a bit, and feel proud. The father mouse comfortably held his little pipe in his mouth, walking ahead. After all, dads always walk in front. 'Hey, are you two crazy? You fools! If Old Cat-Ku-Mo catches you, you're done for. He'll eat you right down to the fur.'

Pride makes fools.

'Should we name the son Lion Tooth,' said the father mouse, 'then he'll be as strong as a lion, and probably grow up to be as big as one. Then he'll be able to handle that rascal fox, scaring him into a cold sweat.'

The mother mouse wanted to name the daughter Silk Claw.

'Because girls should be gentle, lovely, hardworking, and smart,' she said.

'Now, we've thought of everything we need to for the children,' said the father mouse, 'Lion Tooth should be as strong as a lion, and Silk Claw should be a gentle, lovely little mouse.'

But things didn't go as planned.

[P6] Hello, Mr. Butterfly!

Exactly the opposite of what their parents had imagined. Lion Tooth didn't grow at all, remained small and thin, but very clever.

Silk Claw was neither gentle nor cute, and had no interest in knitting or mending. She was bold and reckless, like a bandit chief. When walking? She barely touched the ground, always climbing to the highest branches to swing in the wind. The stronger the wind, the happier she was.

Sometimes, she jumped from high up: "Move aside, Lion Tooth, I'm jumping..."

Sometimes, she climbed a small tree, hung from a leaf, and flew down—parachuting! This was a brave thing, something that made your heart itch. In short, it was wonderful.

But the parents began to worry about them.

"When will these two children ever amount to something?!" the parents worried. The father mouse brought back half a can of strong cat food from the city for Lion Tooth to eat, hoping he would become strong. But Lion Tooth refused, saying:

"Dad, this can tastes like cat food. I won't eat it, because I'm not a cat."

But Silk Claw loved it. She could eat five portions a day, becoming stronger and braver. Soon, parachuting and similar stunts were no longer exciting enough for her.

"Hey, Lion Tooth, look, everyone flies downward," Silk Claw said, "I want to do the opposite—fly upward, like a missile."

"That's not hard," Lion Tooth said. Then he made a device like a mouse slingshot using two willow twigs, stuck the ends into the ground, pressed them down with two big stones, and then all he had to do was call the badger.

12

13

[P7] But the parents were still worried about them.
"This girl can't learn anything," said the mother mouse, "because she has no books." So she carried back seven bags of paper with writing on them from the library. That was enough for a professor to read, of course, a professor not very high in level.

Silk Claws didn't read a single page, while Lion Teeth read every single page. Think about it—this made him so smart.
Soon, flying with the mouse slingshot wasn't exciting enough, high enough, or far enough for Silk Claws.
She wanted to fly in the air, like a bird.
"Get me an airplane, Lion Teeth."
"Too easy," said Lion Teeth, as he placed a net on a sunflower.
"Hello, Mr. Butterfly. Please come over. Smell the sunflower's fragrance—it's not dangerous at all."

"Please come over, Mr. Badger. Help me hold down this end of the mouse slingshot. Yes, yes, like that. Neighbors should always help each other. Alright, now, Silk Claws, get on and launch immediately. Countdown. Ready: Four—three—two—one—zero!"
Oh, so cool!
Did you land safely, Silk Claws?
Congratulations!

[P8] Yes, like that, yes, yes, got it.
"Don't flap your wings so much, it's not as serious as you think. Please forgive us,
we have to tie you up, because we need a little airplane. We'll just borrow you for a moment,
then we'll restore your freedom. Boarding, Silk Claws, into that blue basket. Now pay attention, take off. Wave to me from up there,
my dear little sister."

Oh, awesome.
Below is such a big lawn.
Where are our kind parents? Ah, there...
"Lion Tooth, I'm waving to you. Brother, can you see me?"

[P9] A walnut shell is a little boat,
A button is a little mouse,
And a crown belongs to a king.

"I was a bird for a moment, Lion Tooth, because I flew through the sky," said Silk Claw. "Now I want to be a fish. You get me a submarine."

That's easy to say, but a submarine doesn't fly through the sky. First, you need to know how to make a diving bell for the little mouse. It's easy. First, put a matchbox on the water in the bathtub. The matchbox will float. Then put a small button inside the matchbox. Tie a string to the button. That string is the little tail, and the button is the little mouse. The matchbox is the little boat. Now, take a glass cup, cover the matchbox boat, along with the little mouse and its tail, and press straight down.

What happens? The diving bell has air inside, so the little mouse can breathe. And the little boat won't sink because it's dry. This way, the little mouse can row the little boat around inside the diving bell, looking all around.

Who could make it even more amazing?

Now, you can put a stone on top of the diving bell. Otherwise, the bell will float back up to the surface. The little mouse inside the boat can stay there until all the air is gone, until all the oxygen is used up.

This diving bell will definitely work.
"Silk Claw, you go help me carry things. We need a real little boat."

[P10] Then tie a stone to the glass cup, and throw one end of the rope into the cup.
"Silk Claw, if you want to float to the surface, pull the rope inside the cup. Then the stone will slide down, and the diving bell will rise up. Can you remember?"
No problem.
"Could you come over, Mrs. Otter? Please hold this diving bell carefully, because neighbors should always help each other, right? Now, cover the walnut-shell boat with the diving bell. My sister is sitting inside the boat. Be careful! Now, the diving bell is descending. The submarine is entering the water. Thank you very much, Mrs. Otter."
"It's my duty. After all, neighbors should always help each other."
Who's bothering me, knocking on my submarine? It's a green fellow. The forest ranger is green, but the ranger has a beard. Do you have a beard? No? Then you must be a frog. Do you want to come in, frog? No? Smart. If you do, you still can't get in.
Whose crown is this on the seabed? Maybe it's made of gold? It is gold. A gold crown belongs to a king.
What about this key? Whose key is it? Another king's? No, this key belongs to the guard captain, Stifel Kinevi. Last summer, he lost it while bathing here. This key is for the laundry room, so his wife can't do laundry anymore. Therefore, they don't have clean shirts and pants anymore. So, they have to go around naked everywhere. Why? Because the key wasn't properly looked after.

[P11] Oh, Lion Tooth, how beautiful the world is!
In the field by the front door, Silk Claw said to Lion Tooth:
"The blue sky belongs to us, because we can fly. By the same logic, the sea, the vast wheat fields, and the huge walnut tree all belong to us, because we need them. Lion Tooth, we must understand the whole world, go on a round-the-world trip, not only go, but also come back. How about it?"
"No problem," Lion Tooth said, "There's a farmer named Michel behind this house. He has a great car. Come on, Silk Claw, let's hurry."
Farmer Michel goes into town at seven in the morning to sell eggs and buy nails, because he's repairing the fence.
"Goodbye, dear frog, I'm glad to have met you. I'm going to pull the rope now. After the stone rolls down, the submarine will float up." A wonderful adventure.
22
23

[P12] "Hurry up, Silk Claw, hurry up, it's already half past six, we still have a long way to go. Whoever is late won't get on the car."
Now, jump hard, jump into the taillight, Silk Claw, brother will pull you in! Mr. Michel, your taillight is broken, that's dangerous, you know? This will get you fined. I hope he doesn't get caught by the police, otherwise, Silk Claw will have to run away, and then her round-the-world trip will be ruined.

At this moment, their parents are unnecessarily worrying about them, meaninglessly suffering themselves.
Whenever they sit by the lamp, the mother mends clothes herself, and the father endures the wrist pain from cutting patterns. Then, the father mouse would say:
"What on earth will our children grow up to be? Lion Tooth is as small as a fly, he'll never be able to eat a fox. Oh my!"
The mother mouse is equally dissatisfied with her daughter Silk Claw.

[P13] Seven o'clock. Michel drove off in his noisy car.
"Goodbye, Silk Claws, be back soon!"
"Tell me everything you see, no matter what, I'll be waiting here."
Hey, Mr. Bear, you've been spotted! Hide in the wheat field quickly!

[P14] It was exactly twelve o'clock noon. Farmer Michel came home. He was hungry and wanted to eat lunch. He had also brought nails back from the city. In the city, just as he parked his car, Silk Paws jumped out from the taillight.
"Watch out, you people, or I'll jump onto your feet!"

Silk Paws had冒险ed through the city, risking her life, and almost got stepped on. Be careful, Silk Paws. Luckily, Farmer Michel quickly brought her back.
This was truly a quick trip. Tell me, Silk Paws, what did you see and hear?
"Oh, Lion Tooth, the world is so wonderful," Silk Paws said, "but there are too many people. I managed to escape death, which is lucky. Lion Tooth, my dear brother, we went on a round-the-world trip, right? The world is truly wonderful."
Then, they went home, back to their parents' house to warm up.

Another female mouse and another male mouse
lived in a jam jar, living a happy life,
but they also felt something was missing.

Another beautiful winter had passed. Silk Paws and Lion Tooth went skiing together and threw snowballs at the forest ranger, but missed.
Too far away.
They clenched their fists, shouting and threatening the fox:
"Come over here, you coward! Come over, and we'll peel your skin!"
The fox didn't come. Maybe he was just timid. But for the fox, being timid wasn't bad at all—it saved his life.
Silk Paws and Lion Tooth built a snowman. Oh, sorry, I got it wrong. It should be a snow mouse. A person is a mouse, and a snowman is a snow mouse. That's the right way to say it.

When spring came, Silk Paws married a young male mouse. They lived in a comfortable jam jar, and life was going well, because they had everything they wanted.

[P15] "You know, for our good life, it seems like something's still missing," said Silk Claw.
"I agree," said the young male mouse, "we're missing children, to be precise, we're missing a son."
"We're missing a daughter," said Silk Claw.
"Son."
"Daughter," insisted Silk Claw, "they can help me with sewing."
"A son can eat foxes."
Oh, parents, why do you always argue?
They had many sons and daughters. All children turned out differently from what their parents imagined: exactly the opposite of what they expected.
Hey, Lion Tooth, where are you going?
"I'm going to the city to become a celebrity. Goodbye, friends, one day you'll hear good news about me. Goodbye..."
Goodbye
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页展示了绘本的标题《狮子牙和丝绸爪子》，并介绍了故事背景：一对相爱的小老鼠生了两个孩子，分别叫狮子牙和丝绸爪子。画面中有一幅四口之家的温馨插图。
[P2] 本页描绘了一对住在咖啡壶里的老鼠夫妇，他们生活富足幸福，但总觉得缺少什么。母老鼠表达出想要孩子的愿望，公老鼠也认同并想象了有孩子后生活的美好场景。
[P3] 本页描绘了公老鼠和母老鼠分别幻想拥有儿子和女儿后的生活，并因对孩子的性别期望不同而争吵，最终夏天过去，他们仍未得到孩子。
[P4] 本页讲述了小老鼠夫妇在春天的夜晚生下了两个孩子（一儿一女），他们因孩子性别而短暂争吵，随后为孩子忙碌起来，用火柴盒做小床，用核桃壳做婴儿车，表达了成为父母后的幸福与喜悦。
[P5] 本页描绘了老鼠夫妇带着两个孩子在森林里散步，他们为孩子取名并设想了他们的未来，但最终发现事与愿违。
[P6] 本页描述了两个孩子狮子牙和丝绸爪子与父母期望完全相反的性格和行为：狮子牙瘦小聪明但不爱吃猫粮，丝绸爪子大胆鲁莽且贪吃。父母为他们的成长发愁，而孩子们则在森林中进行各种冒险游戏，展现了他们独特的个性和创造力。
[P7] 本页描绘了老鼠夫妇为孩子们的成长操心，母亲为女儿丝绸爪子带回大量书籍，但女儿对阅读不感兴趣，反而渴望更刺激的飞行；而儿子狮子牙则聪明地阅读了所有书籍。孩子们在森林中用弹弓玩耍，丝绸爪子追求冒险，狮子牙则用智慧制造“飞机”，展现了他们截然不同的个性和创造力。
[P8] 老鼠孩子丝绸爪子和狮子牙用蝴蝶做飞行器，在森林上空玩耍，丝绸爪子兴奋地向地面的弟弟招手，而弟弟则在草地上仰望。
[P9] 老鼠孩子丝绸爪子和狮子牙在森林里用火柴盒、纽扣和玻璃杯制作潜水艇，进行水下探险游戏，展现了他们的想象力和创造力。
[P10] 老鼠孩子丝绸爪子和狮子牙在森林中用玻璃杯和石头制作潜水艇进行水下探险游戏，他们向邻居水獭太太求助，并在水下发现金冠和钥匙，展开想象故事。
[P11] 本页描绘了老鼠兄弟丝绸爪子和狮子牙在田野里讨论环球旅行的冒险计划，他们计划利用农夫米歇尔的汽车出发；同时，画面左侧展现了他们之前水下探险的结尾，向青蛙告别并成功浮出水面，完成了一次美好的冒险。
[P12] 本页描绘了老鼠兄弟丝绸爪子和狮子牙准备乘坐农夫米歇尔的汽车出发环球旅行，同时穿插了他们父母对孩子们未来的担忧与不满，展现了孩子冒险与父母焦虑的对比。
[P13] 老鼠兄弟丝绸爪子和狮子牙乘坐农夫米歇尔的汽车出发，准备开始环球旅行，而他们的父母在麦田里担忧地叮嘱他们，同时提醒熊先生藏好，以免被发现。
[P14] 本页讲述了老鼠孩子丝绸爪子在农夫米歇尔的车里冒险后安全返回，并与弟弟狮子牙分享了城市见闻；同时，故事也描绘了他们长大后在冬天滑雪、堆雪老鼠，以及春天结婚后过上幸福生活的结局。
[P15] 本页通过老鼠父母关于想要儿子还是女儿的对话，展现了父母对孩子的期望与现实的反差，随后以狮子牙告别朋友、准备进城成为名人的场景，暗示了孩子们追求独立与梦想的成长主题。
